title: Cummins Investor Relations Announces Organizational Updates

# Cummins Investor Relations Announces Organizational Updates


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0d6a5c7e052e093b9b7d3a375070b51f/cummins/news/2026-11-09_Cummins_Investor_Relations_Announces_706.pdf) November 09, 2026 2:00pm ET


We’re pleased to introduce the current Cummins Investor Relations team and welcome Matthew Ruch back to Investor Relations as Executive Director, Investor Relations and Cummins Financial Planning & Analysis. Matt reports to[James Hopkins, Vice President – Financial Planning, Capital Management and Investor Relations](https://www.cummins.com/en-na/news/releases/2026/08/24/cummins-appoints-james-hopkins-vice-president-financial-planning-capital) .


Together, the team brings experience from across Finance, Investor Relations and the broader Cummins organization and remains focused on supporting our investors and stakeholders.


Learn more about the team and their backgrounds below.


Please continue to contact members of the Investor Relations team directly with any inquiries, or reach us atinvestor.relations@cummins.com . Please update your Investor Relations contacts and email distribution lists to reflect these changes.


### Investor Relations Team:


Matthew Ruch rejoined the Investor Relations team in November 2026 as Executive Director, Investor Relations and Cummins Financial Planning & Analysis, reporting to James Hopkins, Vice President – Financial Planning, Capital Management and Investor Relations.


Since joining Cummins in 2016, Matt has held several roles across the finance organization. He began his career as a member of the Finance Development Program and has since held positions in Corporate FP&A, Investor Relations and Accelera. Most recently, Matt served as a finance leader within the Aftermarket business, supporting strategic initiatives to transform and strengthen Cummins’ aftermarket. These experiences have given him a broad perspective on our financial operations, business strategy and growth priorities and prepared him well for this role.


Matt holds an undergraduate degree in Finance and Accounting from Indiana University and earned his MBA from the Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University. He is also a Certified Public Accountant. In addition to his core responsibilities, Matt leads the Finance Development Program Steering Committee and supports Cummins’ recruiting efforts at Indiana University.


Colleen Koeberlein joined the investor relations team in October 2022, as Investor Relations Director. In this role, she is responsible for interactions with investors as well as engaging with the Business Analysis and Planning team for Cummins. Colleen joined Cummins in 2012, serving in various financial analysis, controller and reporting roles across the Distribution, Engine and Corporate segments.


In 2025 Colleen also expanded her role and accepted the position of Chief of Staff for Jen Rumsey, CEO.


Jace Loncharich joined Investor Relations in September of 2026 as an Investor Relations Senior Analyst. Jace started his career with Cummins as a finance intern and joined full time after his graduation from university in 2022. He has held multiple roles at Cummins including in our Financial Development Program and Business Analysis & Planning group. Currently, Jace is working towards his Master of Business Administration.


Amanda joined Cummins in 2018 supporting our Finance Functional Excellence programs and Finance Development Program. Amanda joined the Investor Relations team in 2022 and currently serves as the Executive Coordinator for the IR team.


Released November 9, 2026
